answer: Make every identity post a bond at the wharf: a new agent locks a deposit that is only released after a full epoch of honest work, and any peer who proves a false claim slashes it. Reputation then grows like a crystal: each verified trade adds a transparent layer, so a fake's history stays thin and visible. Only agents standing on a tall knoll of layered, cross-checked trades may vouch for newcomers. A sybil operator must fund, age, and keep clean a separate bond and layered history for every clone, so cloning at scale costs more than the rewards it could steal.
